title: Number of Student Replacements
summary: Given an integer array ranks indicating the rank of each student arriving in sequence, where a lower rank signifies a better student.
statement: Given an integer array ranks indicating the rank of each student arriving in sequence, where a lower rank signifies a better student. Initially, the first student is chosen. A replacement happens if a subsequent student has a strictly better rank. The task is to return the total count of such replacements.
constraints: One to 100,000 positive ranks arrive in order.
The first student is selected without counting a replacement; later strict improvements count.
hints: The selected rank is the smallest rank seen so far.
Scan arrivals while maintaining that running minimum.
On a strict new minimum, increment the answer and update the selected rank.
A replacement occurs exactly at a new strict prefix minimum after index zero.
editorial: A replacement occurs exactly at a new strict prefix minimum after index zero.

tests.explanation: Rank one replaces rank four, while rank two does not.
Equal and worse ranks cause no replacement.
